objective: Define business-model-aware, PIT-safe revenue, margin and operating-expense driver forecasting for stock-selection research without duplicating integrated statement, working-capital/FCF, scenario or valuation modules.
corePrinciple: Forecast economically observable drivers first, then transform them into accounting outcomes. A single extrapolated growth rate or margin trend is not a sufficient mechanism and must never become a standalone alpha vote.

accountingFrame.revenueRecognition: IFRS 15 revenue reflects transfer of promised goods/services and transaction price allocated to performance obligations. Orders, shipments, billings, cash receipts and accounting revenue are related but not interchangeable.
accountingFrame.operatingExpensePresentation: IFRS 18 permits operating expenses to be presented by nature, function, or a mixed presentation when that is most useful. Historical OPEX comparison therefore requires a presentation/mapping vintage rather than assuming line-item labels are economically stable.
accountingFrame.taiwanDisclosure: Taiwan MOPS provides issuer operating-revenue announcements with publication timestamps and financial-report releases; research must preserve the original disclosed vintage and publication time rather than use later restated/current values.

manufacturing.guard: Capacity, utilization and yield constrain volume. Revenue growth that exceeds plausible physical capacity without outsourcing/new capacity evidence fails closed.

commodityOrCyclical.guard: Separate commodity price beta from company-specific volume/mix; do not call a spot-price uplift structural margin expansion.

retailOrStore.guard: New-store growth and comparable-store growth are distinct; calendar effects and store openings/closures must not be mixed.

subscriptionOrPlatform.guard: Bookings/users are not revenue without a validated recognition bridge; customer growth with collapsing monetization/churn is not equivalent to revenue quality.

projectOrBacklog.guard: Backlog is not revenue. Conversion probability/timing and contract modifications/variable consideration remain explicit.

financeOrInsurance.guard: Do not force industrial-company gross-margin or sales-to-capital formulas onto financial institutions; use a separate business-model adapter or UNKNOWN.

requiredDecomposition: price versus volume versus mix where economically meaningful
reported versus constant-currency/FX translation effects where material
one-time catch-up, contract modification or accounting-recognition effects
revenueBridge.topDownBottomUpReconciliation: Where data exist, reconcile total-addressable-market/share logic with bottom-up unit/capacity/customer/backlog drivers. Material contradiction lowers confidence rather than selecting the more bullish path.
revenueBridge.seasonality: Seasonality, holiday timing, lunar-calendar shifts, billing cadence and working-day effects require an explicit seasonal model or UNKNOWN. One-month annualization is prohibited.
revenueBridge.monthlyRevenueUse: Taiwan monthly operating-revenue disclosures are PIT inputs for revenue state only. They do not reveal quarterly margin/OPEX by themselves and may not be used to backfill earlier decision dates.

marginBridge.targetMarginRule: A target margin must have an economic anchor such as peer-normalized mature economics, unit-cost path, utilization/scale logic or contractual pricing. Pure mean reversion without mechanism is not sufficient.
marginBridge.accountingGuard: Presentation reclassification, capitalization policy changes, stock-compensation placement and IFRS 18 transition can move reported line items without changing economics; preserve mapped comparable states or UNKNOWN.

opexBridge.guard: Do not force OPEX to a constant percent of revenue when cost behavior or investment phase contradicts that assumption.

pitContract.asOfRule: Every driver and forecast input requires knownAt/availableAt <= forecastDecisionAt.
pitContract.laneRule: Lanes remain separately tagged. Management guidance and analyst consensus cannot be silently relabeled as model facts or issuer actuals.
pitContract.cadenceRule: Different input frequencies remain different. Monthly revenue may update before quarterly margins/OPEX; never interpolate later quarter margins backward into earlier monthly decisions.
pitContract.revisionRule: Corrections, restatements, guidance changes, contract modifications and realized outcomes append as later vintages and never rewrite the ex-ante forecast.
pitContract.unknownRule: Unavailable price/volume/mix, capacity, margin bridge or OPEX driver stays UNKNOWN; later realized values cannot reconstruct it.

ownershipBoundary.D07_20: Consumes D07-21 drivers and owns integrated three-statement reconciliation/funding/circularity. D07-21 does not duplicate the statement-balancing vote.
ownershipBoundary.D07_22: Owns working-capital, CAPEX and FCF forecast detail. D07-21 may identify operational drivers but does not create a second reinvestment/FCF score.
ownershipBoundary.D07_23: Owns scenario and sensitivity design. D07-21 supplies frozen driver states/uncertainties rather than outcome-tuned scenarios.
ownershipBoundary.D07_19: Owns project economics/NPV/real options. Capacity projects can supply driver constraints but are not independently re-scored here.
ownershipBoundary.D08: Consumes revenue/margin/OPEX forecasts for valuation. Forecast optimism is not an independent valuation confirmation.
ownershipBoundary.D10_D09: Industry/supply-chain and sector context may supply external demand/price/capacity evidence but retain their own ownership.

falsification: Reject universal straight-line revenue extrapolation when the business has observable capacity/customer/backlog constraints.
Reject price-times-volume decomposition when revenue recognition timing or variable consideration breaks the mapping.
Reject top-down market-share forecasts that require implausible market share, capacity or customer acquisition.
Reject margin expansion caused only by classification/presentation changes or unsupported peer convergence.
Reject OPEX leverage that requires implausible fixed-cost behavior or ignores deliberate growth investment.
Reject monthly-revenue information leakage from disclosures published after the historical decision timestamp.
Reject later quarterly margin/OPEX actuals backfilled into earlier monthly forecasts.
Reject a driver family if incremental value disappears after simpler current revenue growth, margin, FCF, leverage, consensus and valuation controls.
Reject promotion if evidence is concentrated in one issuer, one industry, one accounting regime or one high-growth cycle.
Preserve negative and null evidence; do not select driver definitions/windows after seeing returns.
researchHypotheses: H1: Driver-consistent forecasts should reduce false-positive revenue acceleration signals when capacity, utilization, price/mix or customer economics contradict headline growth.
H2: Margin-bridge consistency may be more useful as downside-risk/quality validation than as standalone short-horizon alpha.
H3: Taiwan monthly operating-revenue vintages may improve revenue nowcasting, but should not be assumed to reveal margin or earnings without separate cost/expense states.
H4: Business-model-specific adapters should outperform a universal sales-growth/margin template in forecast calibration and failure detection.
H5: Incremental value, if any, must survive controls for current growth, valuation, trend/RS, industry/regime and information already embedded in consensus.
taiwanPITReplayPlan: Freeze original MOPS monthly operating-revenue releases with displayed publication timestamps and correction lineage.
Join only financial-report/guidance information available by each forecastDecisionAt.
Replay at least four Taiwan-listed issuers across at least three materially different industries/business models.
Include at least one capacity-constrained manufacturer, one price/mix-sensitive cyclical or hardware issuer, and one service/retail/recurring-revenue style issuer where source data permit.
Preserve monthly-versus-quarterly cadence mismatch rather than filling quarterly margins into prior months.
Include at least one restatement/reclassification/IFRS-presentation case and at least one negative forecast case.

maturityDecision.rationale: Business-model adapters, revenue/margin/OPEX bridges, accounting-recognition/presentation guards, PIT provenance, ownership boundaries and falsification are explicit. Taiwan issuer historical replay is not yet physically validated, so L3 remains closed.

l3Gate: At least four Taiwan-listed issuers across at least three materially different industries/business models.
Replayable original monthly-revenue and financial-report vintages with publication/availability timestamps.
Management guidance, analyst consensus and model assumptions separately tagged.
At least one revenue-recognition/cadence mismatch case and one margin/OPEX presentation or reclassification case.
Append-only correction/restatement handling with no outcome leakage.
Demonstrated driver-to-reported-revenue/margin bridge with explicit UNKNOWN where mapping is unavailable.
l4Gate: Common-support comparison against simple revenue-growth, margin, FCF, leverage and consensus baselines.
Coverage/missingness and forecast-error distributions, including negative/null results.
